prompt:
Research the fee OpenRouter charges when buying credits (card and crypto), and any fee on bring-your-own-key usage. Cite OpenRouter's own documentation or FAQ and quote it.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Below are the requested attribution lines.

SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/docs/faq | QUOTE: "OpenRouter charges a 5.5% ($0.80 minimum) fee when you purchase credits." | CLAIM: OpenRouter charges a 5.5% fee, with a $0.80 minimum, when you purchase credits.
SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/docs/faq | QUOTE: "Crypto payments are charged a fee of 5%." | CLAIM: Buying credits with crypto is charged a 5% fee.
SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/docs/faq | QUOTE: "We pass through the pricing of the underlying providers; there is no markup on inference pricing (however we do charge a fee when purchasing credits)." | CLAIM: OpenRouter does not mark up inference pricing, but it does charge a fee when purchasing credits.
SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/docs/faq | QUOTE: "Pay-as-you-go includes $25,000 per month with no BYOK fee, while Enterprise allowances are custom." | CLAIM: BYOK includes a $25,000/month free allowance on the pay-as-you-go plan, with custom allowances for Enterprise.
SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/docs/faq | QUOTE: "Usage above the allowance has a fee of 5% of what the same model and provider would normally cost on OpenRouter." | CLAIM: BYOK usage above the included allowance is charged 5% of the normal OpenRouter cost for the same model/provider.
SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/docs/faq | QUOTE: "This fee is deducted from your OpenRouter credits." | CLAIM: The BYOK overage fee is deducted from OpenRouter credits.
SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/auth/byok | QUOTE: "The cost of using custom provider keys on OpenRouter is 5% of what the same model/provider would cost normally on OpenRouter and will be deducted from your OpenRouter credits." | CLAIM: Using custom provider keys (BYOK) costs 5% of the normal OpenRouter cost and is deducted from OpenRouter credits.
SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/pricing | QUOTE: "BYOK Limits Learn more → | Free No | Standard $25,000 of list price inference / month with no fees, 5% fee after | Business $25,000 of list price inference / month with no fees, 5% fee after | Enterprise Custom" | CLAIM: OpenRouter's pricing page lists the Standard/Business BYOK terms as $25,000 of list-price inference per month with no fees, then 5% after; Free has no BYOK and Enterprise is custom.
SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/blog/announcements/simplifying-our-platform-fee/ | QUOTE: "Non-crypto payments: 5.5% of the order amount, with a minimum fee of $0.80" | CLAIM: For non-crypto credit purchases (e.g., card), the fee is 5.5% of the order amount with a $0.80 minimum.
